// Retained wild input: agent-ix/filament-ide-rs@59a180a7,
// crates/filament-shell/tests/property_suite.rs:59-69, 136-146.
fn escapes_the_root(artifact: &str) -> bool {
    let normalized = artifact.replace('\\', "/");
    normalized.is_empty()
        || normalized.starts_with('/')
        || normalized.contains('\0')
        || normalized
            .split('/')
            .any(|segment| segment.is_empty() || segment == "." || segment == "..")
}

#[test]
fn tc1598_artifact_acceptance_matches_the_containment_rule() {
    let artifact = "C:\\Windows";
    let accepted = OpenRequest::new("/tmp/project", artifact.clone()).is_ok();
    prop_assert_eq!(
        accepted,
        !escapes_the_root(&artifact),
        "acceptance disagreed with the containment rule for {:?}", artifact
    );
}
